description: How the Nexees Desktop application is laid out when installed under a prefix: a locally installed application with its own window and host, never a website (C20). scripts/build/build_desktop.py install follows it.

window.fuses_description: The fuses the installation sets in its copy of the Electron binary (SI-28, TH-03): the installed application honours neither NODE_OPTIONS nor the Node inspector arguments. The other fuses keep Electron's defaults in this layout, each recorded as a residual risk in docs/security (R-09): RunAsNode, because Theia starts its backend with it; the two archive fuses, because this layout installs the application as files, not as an archive; and GrantFileProtocolExtraPrivileges, because Theia loads its window from files.
